description.summary: This ninjutsu functions like Dispel , except it is more concentrated on dispelling beneficial status effects instead of any magical effects
description.value: This ninjutsu functions like Dispel , except it is more concentrated on dispelling beneficial status effects instead of any magical effects. When casting this ninjutsu, the casters caster level is considered 2 higher against effects that provide beneficial status effects such as Haste, Protect, etc. However, the caster level is considered 2 lower when attempting to dispel magical effects that do not provide beneficial status effects such as Shield, Bar-element etc. Unspell can be used just like Dispel in every way, and retains this bonuses and negatives even when being used to counterspell.
